facts.title: crafterui - Less is more
facts.description: A collection of Open Source motion and interaction components that you can customize, extend, and build on. React + Tailwind, on the shadcn registry - copy the source or install with the shadcn CLI.

research.name: crafterui
research.note: Open source React and Tailwind motion components on the shadcn registry, such as pixel-dissolving 3D image carousels and gooey dials.

effects: Dither helix carousel: images orbit in 3D and dissolve into pixel dither at the edges
Liquid metal gooey surfaces (Mercury Dial, Mercury Menu, Molten Ring Carousel)

unverified: The component source is public at github.com/SriSomanaath/crafterui (MIT, 4 stars); that repository has not yet been researched as a repo candidate.
The Mercury Dial screenshot showed only its idle button, so the gooey effect was named from the site's category text, not seen animating.
